geography.source: INE municipality codes and official Spanish administrative boundary releases

rules.padel: Major padel facilities/courts qualify only with geotag, official municipality crosswalk, source provenance and significance evidence.
rules.football: Football stadiums qualify as primary municipal anchors when documented as part of or co-located within the same municipal sports complex as the major padel anchor.
rules.tennis: Tennis is selective: significant or sustainability-relevant tennis facilities in Polideportivos with Ayuntamientos management and documented municipal/sustainability evidence.

factors.label: Observed rainfall
factors.reportability: REPORTABLE after source, time, unit, spatial and QC validation

factors.label: Rainfall forecast
factors.reportability: CONTEXT_ONLY until independently validated against observations

factors.label: Potential rainwater yield
factors.reportability: CALCULATED_CONTEXT_ONLY until catchment assumptions and method are approved

factors.label: Measured harvested rainwater
factors.reportability: REPORTABLE after calibrated measurement, site authorization and source QC

factors.label: Water quality, batch and seal
factors.reportability: PREMIUM_REVIEW only after QMS, custody, batch, seal and applicable regulatory/product-release gates

factors.label: GHG inventory / avoided emissions
factors.reportability: CALCULATED_REVIEW_PENDING until methodology and boundary review

factors.label: Sports participation and inclusion
factors.reportability: REVIEW_PENDING until denominator, privacy and safeguarding rules pass

factors.label: Municipal authorization and governance
factors.reportability: REVIEW_PENDING until authority and evidence are confirmed
factors.notEquivalentTo: Public endorsement inferred from venue location

factors.label: Evidence package integrity
factors.reportability: ANCHORED only after readback reproduces the package root
factors.notEquivalentTo: Truth, additionality, water quality or credit issuance

factors.label: Municipal climate-finance eligibility readiness
factors.reportability: READINESS_ONLY until every applicable methodology, independent assurance, legal and registry gate is accepted
factors.notEquivalentTo: Issued carbon credits, approved financial instruments or municipal endorsement

brandProvenance.releaseGate: Do not print Premium/verified/product-release claims until QMS, batch, seal, review and applicable legal/product approvals pass.
brandProvenance.timestampPolicy: Store harvest timestamp, evidence-package creation timestamp and blockchain block timestamp as separate fields; never substitute one for another.
brandProvenance.anchorPolicy: If anchorStatus is ANCHORED, include network ID, transaction hash, block number and block timestamp, plus an independent readback whose root exactly matches the package SHA-256 root. An anchor does not approve water quality or product release.
brandProvenance.qrLinkPolicy: A QR verification link may be added only when it resolves to an authorized public batch record; never expose private telemetry, personal data or sensitive site coordinates.

financeBoundary.municipalCarbonFinance: Potential municipal climate-finance opportunities must be quantified from eligible, additional, measured and independently verified activities under an applicable methodology.
financeBoundary.credits: No credit is created by a map pin, sports event, rainfall forecast, bottle label, evidence hash or token.
financeBoundary.tokens: Any project token or financial instrument requires separate legal, regulatory, accounting, custody, consumer and governance review.
financeBoundary.readinessReport: Municipal climate-finance readiness is a documentary and methodology gate, not a credit or revenue claim.
